newsitem.title: GERMANY: BMW says no decision yet on Latam plant.
newsitem.headline: BMW says no decision yet on Latam plant.

text.p: German carmaker BMW AG said on Friday that no decision has yet been made on the location for a engine factory in Latin America as part of a joint venture with U.S. carmaker Chrysler Corp.
A BMW spokesman made the statement in response to a Reuter enquiry after the mayor of Medellin, Colombia, said BMW officials had expressed an interest in setting up an assembly plant near the city.
BMW and Chrysler announced at the Paris car show last week that they would invest up to $500 million to establish a Latin American joint venture to produce small car engines.
The project will produce up to 400,000 four-cylinder engines a year and will begin operations by the end of 1999.
